nodes.label: ADR 0156: GLUE Home answers the account's other devices in Rust
nodes.rationale: Moves GLUE Home's cloud-side request handling from JavaScript service page to Rust engine. Answers to device requests (get, thumbs, details, art, incoming, analysis) run in parallel threads in Engine::answer instead of single-threaded page handler. Enables E4b of the plan.

nodes.label: Engine::answer implementation
nodes.rationale: Core handler in crates/glue-engine/src/answers.rs that answers each request: data and bytes, or a song's file from disk. Replaces service.ts onRequest, cache.ts, lookup.ts handlers. Implements get, range, thumbs, details, have, art, find-art, incoming, get-incoming, move-incoming, folders, local, analysis request types.

nodes.label: Cover look-up implementation
nodes.rationale: Rust port of JavaScript coverSearch.ts, names.ts bare, and lookup.ts. Searches for covers using identical keys, addresses and picks as website. Validated against tests/golden/covers.json recorded by tests/covers.golden.test.ts. Maintains exact compatibility: lowercase, NFKD normalization, ASCII-only \b and ?? operators, UTF-16 string length counting.

nodes.label: Incoming folder handler
nodes.rationale: Implements incoming, get-incoming, move-incoming request handlers in crates/glue-engine/src/incoming.rs. Manages incoming folder list and moves using naming rules GLUE Home now uses directly.

nodes.label: Names normalization
nodes.rationale: Rust port of JavaScript names.ts bare function and lookup logic in crates/glue-engine/src/names.rs for cover search name normalization.

nodes.label: GLUE Home connection handler
nodes.rationale: In home/src-tauri/src/rtc.rs: calls engine.answer for each request on its own thread, answers through glue-rtc reply/send_file/error. Replaces rtc_reply, rtc_send_file, rtc_error commands. Counts responses for settings (rtc-served). Signals rtc_busy when updates must wait.

nodes.label: ADR 0155: The shared sync in Rust
Engine answer tests
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive tests in crates/glue-engine/tests/answers.rs: real song analysis when requested, parts, cover, file, incoming folder, cover look-up once and refusal.

nodes.label: GLUE Home connection e2e tests
nodes.rationale: In e2e/home-rtc.ts: asks test engine's answer command as rtc.rs does. Fake GLUE Home keeps engine reads from disk (songs received, incoming analyses, other devices' puts). Answers cover service queries. Tests via __enginePort when local link disabled.

nodes.label: Cover look-up golden tests
nodes.rationale: tests/covers.golden.test.ts records cover search golden data in tests/golden/covers.json. Replayed by crates/glue-engine/tests/covers_golden.rs to ensure Rust implementation matches JavaScript behavior.

nodes.label: Parallel request handling
nodes.rationale: Request handlers run in parallel threads instead of single-threaded page. Slow operations (analysis) don't block others. Background thumbnails wait while GLUE Home serves devices, analyses, or library scan, and until library analysis has looked once.

nodes.label: Device request types
nodes.rationale: Request types handled by Engine::answer: get, range, thumbs, details, have, art, find-art, incoming, get-incoming, move-incoming, folders, local, analysis.
